**[id 170]** The hat costs $25. The jacket costs 3 × 25 = $75. The pants cost (25 + 75) / 2 = $50. Each uniform costs 25 + 75 + 50 = **150**.

**[id 171]** Spiders have 80 × 8 = 640 legs. Insects have 90 × 6 = 540 legs. The mutants have 3 × 10 = 30 legs. Jake sees 640 + 540 + 30 = **1210** legs.

**[id 172]** Sally Four is 8, the same as Sally Thirtytwo. Granny Red is 2 × 8 = 16. Sally Two is 16 + 3 = 19. The total age is 8 + 8 + 16 + 19 = **51**.

**[id 173]** The minimums add up to 300 + 200 + 500 = $1000 per month. Paying 50% more gives $1500 per month. Over a year that is 1500 × 12 = **18000**.

**[id 174]** Each potato takes 90 + 5 = 95 seconds. For 60 potatoes that is 60 × 95 = 5700 seconds, which is **95** minutes.

**[id 175]** Each gallon brings in 20 × $0.50 = $10 and costs $5, so the profit is $5 per gallon. A $25 profit means they made 5 gallons. Lemons cost 5 × $3 = **15**.

**[id 176]** There were 240 − 80 = 160 Chinese runners. With 60 boys, there were 160 − 60 = **100** girls.

**[id 177]** Rent is $1500 and fuel is $2000, leaving $2500. He donates half, leaving $1250. After giving $900 to his daughter and wife, he has 1250 − 900 = **350**.

**[id 178]** Bo has 40 crabs. Monic has 40 − 4 = 36. Rani has 36 + 10 = 46. Together they have 40 + 36 + 46 = **122**.

**[id 179]** Lloyd worked 5 + 8 = 13 hours at $10 per hour, so he earned **130**.
